data.title: AI writes. [[You]] decide what's worth saying.
data.subtitle: Six fixes for LinkedIn posts that sound like everyone else's

cards.title: Give first
cards.text: Every post hands the reader something: a lesson, a method, a warning.

cards.title: Break your pattern
cards.text: Same opening, same shape, same topic every week? Change one thing.

cards.title: Fix the visual
cards.text: A clear photo, a short document or a simple chart that matches the words.

cards.title: Stay steady
cards.text: A rhythm you can keep beats a burst you can't. Draft and schedule ahead.

cards.title: Pick your people
cards.text: Decide who you want reading, then write for that one person.

cards.title: Keep your voice
cards.text: Use AI to question, sort and tighten your ideas. The words stay yours.
